notes.subject: ye
notes.rationale: Bamanankan ka wajibi kuma-yɛlɛma daɲɛ (copula), Heburukan ma a sɛbɛn

notes.subject: kodo-senu mayɔrɔ ɲɛda
notes.rationale: Heburukan kumasen in gɛlɛn: 'ɲɛda-cogo ye ɲɛda-cogo ye' — nɔnabila dɔw fɔ ko hayikali ni senumayɔrɔ ɲɛda-cogow bɛ lamɛn, nɔnabila wɛrɛw b'a jira ko cogo kelen dɔrɔn de bɛ yen

notes.subject: naani-ɲɛ-yɛrɛ
notes.rationale: So-dilan kɔlɔsili daɲɛ — jɔ-yɔrɔ ka jate ni a cogo ye

translation: Hayikali da-misɛnw kɛra naani-ɲɛ-yɛrɛ ye, ani kodo-senu mayɔrɔ ɲɛda: ɲɛda-cogo ye ⟨ye⟩ ɲɛda-cogo yɛrɛ.
